title: Stargate staff came from Sidney Gottlieb's Technical Services Staff

tellings.quote: know that actually a lot of original people who were on that program came from Sydney Gotaut's technical staff services.

plain: A podcast host named Jesse Michels says that many of the original people on Stargate, a US government program at the Stanford Research Institute in California that tried to use the mind to see distant places, came from the technical services staff of Sidney Gottlieb, a CIA scientist. He tells it because, if true, it would tie the psychic research to the CIA's own secret experiments.
